# Subway Seat for cava

Bars rise through the 70s stripe: avocado at the floor, then harvest gold, burnt orange and redbird at the peaks. On cava without theme files, paste the `[color]` block into your config.

[cava](https://github.com/karlstav/cava) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/cava/)

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:

```ini
[color]
theme = 'subway-seat'
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:

```ini
[color]
theme = 'subway-seat-tunnel'
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:

```ini
[color]
theme = 'subway-seat-enamel'
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:


**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:


**London Portland**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:


**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:

**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.config/cava/config, with the theme file in ~/.config/cava/themes/:

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/cava/themes/subway-seat`.
- Delete `~/.config/cava/themes/subway-seat-tunnel`.
- Delete `~/.config/cava/themes/subway-seat-enamel`.
- Delete `~/.config/cava/themes/london-moquette`.
- Delete `~/.config/cava/themes/london-deep-level`.
- Delete `~/.config/cava/themes/london-portland`.
- Delete `~/.config/cava/themes/paris-guimard`.
- Delete `~/.config/cava/themes/paris-catacombes`.
- Delete `~/.config/cava/themes/paris-carrelage`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
